subject: scripts/hooks.py: 'actl hooks install|check' writes the three Claude Code hook entries of <project>/.claude/settings.json pointing into AC_HOME; A's own settings.json is a managed instance
objective: Design docs/design/project-runnable-entries.md (D-071) C8, section 5, section 8 V13, follow-up row 4. Entry name actl (D-072). (1) scripts/hooks.py <install|check> [--project <dir>]; the project root is --project, else AC_ROOT (set by actl); AC_HOME required (rc 2 'AC_HOME not set' when absent). bin/actl's 'hooks' row (a 'not landed yet' stub since #159) now execs it. (2) A managed entry = an item of hooks.<event>[].hooks[] whose command names one of the basenames session-hook.sh, agent-cost-hook.py, guard-main.sh, main_guard.py at any path. The target set (design section 5): SessionStart matcher 'startup|resume|clear|compact|fork' -> sh <HOME>/scripts/session-hook.sh timeout 60; SubagentStop -> python3 <HOME>/scripts/agent-cost-hook.py timeout 10; SessionEnd -> the same, timeout 10. <HOME> spelling: when realpath(project) == realpath(AC_HOME) (dogfood, A's own committed file) write "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/<hook>" double-quoted exactly as A's .claude/settings.json reads today (a committed file must not carry a machine path: tests/test_no_project_names.py treats .json as code level and forbids home paths); otherwise the absolute realpath of AC_HOME, double-quoted. Opener's ruling, main to confirm (outline). (3) install: creates .claude/ and the file ({} start) when absent; rewrites every managed entry to the target set; adds target entries that are missing; deletes a managed entry whose first path-looking token (after the interpreter word, quotes stripped, $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR expanded to the project root) is a missing file; leaves every non-managed entry and every other top-level key byte for byte; keeps key order; writes json indent 2 + trailing newline; prints a unified diff of the file (old vs new), or the single line 'hooks: no change'; rc 0. Not valid JSON -> rc 2, file untouched. (4) check: same computation, prints the same diff, never writes; rc 1 when install would change anything, 0 otherwise, 2 when not valid JSON. (5) Dogfood: 'actl hooks check' in A on the committed .claude/settings.json is rc 0; tests/test_session_hook.py A1 keeps pinning the shape and gains that arm. (6) The two 'please paste' lines printed by sync-to-project.sh today (412, 464-465) are not touched here: row 6 (#166) deletes that script; hooks.py is their replacement. (7) #160's doctor row 'hook points at a missing file -> actl hooks install' is the text this command resolves; nothing in project_config.py changes here.
acceptance: A1 install twice (tests/test_hooks.py, new; harness sandbox at config_version 2, sandbox != AC_HOME; scripts via $AC_HOME/bin/actl): sandbox without .claude/ -> 'actl hooks install' rc 0, stdout has '+' lines containing session-hook.sh and agent-cost-hook.py; the file loads; keys SessionStart, SubagentStop, SessionEnd present; SessionStart matcher == 'startup|resume|clear|compact|fork', its command == 'sh "<H>/scripts/session-hook.sh"' where <H> = realpath of the AC_HOME the test set (expected string built by the test, not read from output), timeouts 60/10/10. Second install: rc 0, stdout contains 'no change', file byte-identical.

A2 V13 foreign survives, missing managed removed (tests/test_hooks.py): the test prewrites settings.json with (a) a PreToolUse entry {matcher 'Bash', command 'echo foreign-hook'}, (b) a SessionStart entry whose command is 'sh "<sandbox>/scripts/control/guard-main.sh"' (file absent), (c) a top-level "permissions" object, in that key order. After 'actl hooks install' rc 0: the parsed (a) and (c) subtrees are equal to what was written, top-level key order is permissions-after-hooks exactly as written, no command in the file contains 'guard-main.sh', stdout has a '-' line containing guard-main.sh and '+' lines for the three targets.

A3 check (tests/test_hooks.py): after A1's install, 'actl hooks check' rc 0 and stdout has no line starting with '+' or '-' (or contains 'no change'); the test then appends ' --x' to the SessionStart command -> check rc 1, stdout has a '-' line containing '--x' and a '+' line without it, file byte-identical before/after check; file content '{' -> check rc 2 and install rc 2, file byte-identical, stderr names the file.

A4 dogfood (tests/test_session_hook.py A1HookShape, static): 'python3 scripts/hooks.py check --project <A root>' with AC_HOME=<A root> rc 0 on the committed .claude/settings.json; the committed file's three commands contain '$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR' and no '/home/' or home-directory path; the existing A1 assertions (command contains scripts/session-hook.sh, matcher subset of the five sources) unchanged and green.

A5 actl wiring + doctor handshake (tests/test_hooks.py): 'actl hooks check' in a version-2 sandbox without settings.json -> rc 1 and '+' lines; 'actl hooks nonsense' -> rc 2; a sandbox whose settings.json names a missing guard-main.sh -> 'actl doctor' stdout contains 'actl hooks install' (the #160 row); after 'actl hooks install' -> 'actl doctor' stdout contains no 'hooks install' and rc 0.
